rows.title: Effect of probiotic supplementation on psychological stress in healthy adults with moderate stress levels: a randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled clinical trial.
rows.focus: In a five-arm randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial of 766 adults with moderate stress, Lactococcus lactis supplementation did not significantly improve stress, anxiety, depression, sleep quality, cortisol, or inflammatory markers versus placebo. A viability shortfall in one probiotic arm also highlights formulation and delivered-dose integrity.
